name: rbp-recruitment
description: Remote Business Partner recruitment website — Cloudflare Pages + Pages Functions + D1 + private R2 + Firebase Authentication + Cloudflare Turnstile. See DEPLOYMENT.md for the full setup/deploy procedure and PRELAUNCH_BLOCKERS.md for items that must be resolved before real candidate/employer data is collected.

scripts.deploy: npm run prelaunch && wrangler pages deploy .

notes: jose is required by functions/_lib/auth.js to cryptographically verify Firebase-issued RS256 ID tokens against Google's published JWKS (spec item 27). Raw ASN.1/X.509 parsing was deliberately NOT hand-rolled.
wrangler is required to run D1 migrations, emulate D1/R2 locally (`npm run dev`), and deploy (`npm run deploy`).

This package.json has never been installed or run inside the GenSpark editor that produced this code — the editor has no tool that can execute npm install, wrangler, or any build/deploy command. Run `npm install` yourself in a real Node.js + Wrangler environment before using any of these scripts.
`npm run deploy` intentionally runs the prelaunch check first and aborts the deploy if it fails.
